newsitem.title: USA: Packaging Plus acquires Britain's SkyNet.
newsitem.headline: Packaging Plus acquires Britain's SkyNet.

text.p: Packaging Plus Services Inc on Wednesday said it acquired SkyNet Worldwide Express, an international express courier based in Britain.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed. Packaging Plus said the deal would boost its annual sales to more than $115 million from $4 million.
The U.S. company said the acquisition was its first major step in becoming a full-service packaging, shipping and related services company.
It said the purchase includes SkyNet's hubs in London, New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco and Sydney and a member network of 160 affiliates for delivering packages worldwide.
Packaging Plus provides packaging, shipping, advertising and concierge services. The company also owns a trade association known as APAC, which serves independent postal stores in the United States.
